notes.title: Crackhead Jack: Overdose Edition Steam Deck Support
notes.notes:
The Adventures of Crackhead Jack: Overdose Edition is 50% off as part of the new annual Spring Sale until March 23! 

The Steam Deck also happens to be 10% off. To celebrate, I've put together a short gameplay video of the game running on Deck. 

[previewyoutube=fIDDMtADJiY;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] [b]Proton version[/b]: 4.11-13 (the game will launch with a black screen on any newer version)
[*] [b]Steam Input configuration[/b]: Gamepad (Steam template)
[*] [b]Performance Settings[/b]: 5W TDP limit
[*] [b](in-game) Resolution[/b]: Original
[*] [b](in-game) Text SE[/b]: Off ("On" causes significant stuttering)
[/list]
With these settings, Bluetooth on, and 50% brightness, I get an average of 4 hours of battery life. You could probably optimize further for 5-6 hours if you cap framerate and TDP even more. If you're fast, you could complete the game on a single charge!

If you have a Steam Deck and the game, please report your findings on [url=https://www.protondb.com/app/1328500]ProtonDB[/url]! 

[hr][/hr]
Buy the game below!

notes.title: v1.0.0.2 - Fullscreen support and fixes
notes.notes:
The [b]v1.0.0.2[/b] update brings a couple of bug fixes and addresses potential crashes. Plus, fullscreen support is added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168228/b42b5f061bc890c541e76c5defcb3bb61fa1b9b8.jpg[/img]

[b]With the removal of F1/F12 use, Steam may prompt you to install Visual C++ 2013 Redist, much like when you run a game with a "first time setup". Worry not.[/b]

[h2]Minor changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added fullscreen support. Press F5 to toggle, and F6 to adjust window size ratios.
[*] Readjusted some Stun chances on late-game weapons
[*] Removed the ability to use the RPGMaker default binds (F1, F12, Alt+Enter)
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemies in [spoiler]Depths, Sodatown Port, and the Cruise[/spoiler] used old events where using the horn could break respawn timers
[*] A sidequest item at [spoiler]Route 10 Lot[/spoiler] was unusable
[*] Auto-win events used an incorrect version of a skill
[*] Leftover debug messages when using a [spoiler]Plastic Knife[/spoiler]
[*] Some achievements were unobtainable (specifically, [spoiler]When the Sun Hits[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Lost Boys[/spoiler])
[/list]

Best of luck in finding your crack. If you liked the game, give it a review.

notes.title: Crackhead Jack: Overdose Edition - Breakdown of Changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168228/41c1a482604be39b09a5ec7a7f229c160fe79ca1.jpg[/img]
This announcement post is be a breakdown of some of the changes between The Adventures of Crackhead Jack: Classic and Overdose Edition listed in the store description.

[h3]Overhaul of Random Encounters[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168228/17e753cc8f41aa24968bf3da7cd9cd5fba02d432.jpg[/img]

In Classic, battles began at random points walking around a map that had enemy encounters. Overdose overhauls this system and places visible enemies that you can run away from! They also initially spawn at the same places, if some players are into that. In addition, they can be respawned when using a horn!

[h3]Revamped Areas and Towns[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168228/a3c6633a9e92933eeb76be393739ef7058cb78da.jpg[/img]

Some maps in Overdose Edition now have new layouts, have been redone completely, or have had some extra visual change. With the rewriting of the story, some maps have been replaced with all new areas. I didn't want to spoil new areas here, so I won't.

[h3]Over 50 New Attack Animations[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168228/447cc7333cafc1275a1b842795edd55d78d07571.jpg[/img]

I wanted to keep a more consistent visual look in comparison to the messy look of the original. So, all the stock image animations have been replaced with new sprites.

[h3]UI Enhancements[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168228/f5943303436a882163b785a5305262ca0cc90264.jpg[/img]

The game's font is now in a monospace and more fitting font! Along with this, a bunch of game windows have been cleaned up, as well as more consistent game prompts.

[h3]Extra System Options[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168228/66b5400f9bf6d11e50cdabbc7b721dd6c3a934ae.jpg[/img]
 
Overdose Edition adds the next-gen feature of a volume slider, and multiple resolutions! Fullscreen can also be toggled using F5, and resized using F6.

[h3]Other new changes[/h3]

- [b]Steam Cloud and Achievements[/b] - Your saves are safe across updates and new computers. There are [b]30 Steam achievements[/b] to complete, and it won't be easy.

- [b]Better XInput support[/b] - Classic only had limited support for some DInput and XInput pads. That was the extent of my testing for Classic, at least. Now everything should work smoothly with a couple of configurations to Steam-supported controllers!

- [b]New soundtrack[/b] - Artists Sam Wakeman, Yung Data, Mason Rhodes, and Lil Daddy Kane were gracious enough to give a unique sound to the new edition! Now we are no longer left with random ripped chiptune remixes off the internet... consider supporting the soundtrack artists by buying the OST or OST bundle, at a discounted price!

[h3]Closing[/h3]

Hopefully this convinces some of you to try the new Overdose edition and abandon the old and dirty Classic version...
